description: A flow runs sub/child.jos as a type: jos step; sub/.jos/ grants only engine:jos and fs:read:. and avoids SECRET. The step runs under its own chain intersected with the caller's: engine:shell is not granted (code 3), nothing is launched; run directly, the child is code 3 as well (K11, SPEC-2.0 §9.1-9.2).
